source.post_text:
you can literally build + launch a software startup for basically $20/month now..

and i mean an actual product with users, database, auth, emails, analytics and payments..

the whole stack:

- Claude Code = build the product ($20/mo)
- Supabase = backend + database (free tier)
- Cloudflare = hosting + deployment (free tier)
- GitHub = version control (free)
- Clerk = user login/auth (free up to 50k retained users)
- Resend = emails (3k/month free)
- PostHog = analytics (1M events/month free)
- Sentry = error tracking (free tier)
…

replies.text: Wild how cheap the full stack got, though it still comes down to whether you can pick one idea and actually finish it before the free tiers start adding up.
